key_facts: NullClaw is a lightweight AI agent framework written in Zig
Binary size is 678 KB, runs on just 1 MB RAM, and boots in 2 milliseconds
Designed as a low-overhead alternative to Python/Go-based agentic frameworks, eliminating GC and VM runtime overhead
analyst_angle: NullClaw signals a strategic shift toward systems-language AI infrastructure—prioritizing determinism, memory safety, and embedded deployability over ecosystem convenience, potentially enabling AI agents on edge devices and safety-critical systems.
